summary: A joint scholarship of ICESCO and the Uzbek Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovations for outstanding students from ICESCO member states. In its first phase it offers five scholarships at bachelor's level at two universities in Uzbekistan: three in General Medicine at Tashkent State Medical University and two at the Central Asian University for Environmental and Climate Change Studies (Green University). It covers tuition, student housing, a monthly stipend and health services in public institutions. Applications ran from 1 March to 15 May 2026.
eligibility_notes:
Applicants must be nationals of an ICESCO member state (53 states are listed on ICESCO's member-state page). The scholarship targets outstanding or academically strong students and is for bachelor's study only.

Tashkent State Medical University (3 places, General Medicine): English at B1 level or higher, which the page equates to IELTS 5.0 or an equivalent score.

Green University (2 places, environment-related bachelor's programmes): English proof as one of IELTS 5.5 or higher, TOEFL PBT 453, CBT 133 or iBT 46 or higher, or a certificate of graduation from an international secondary school where all teaching was in English. Applicants without a valid certificate sit the university entrance exam, which is in IELTS-like format (listening, reading, writing, speaking) on environment, ecology and climate change topics.

Candidates may be invited to an interview after applying. Documents must be clear and legible, in English or with a certified English translation, as PDF files of at most 5 MB each.

No age limit and no minimum grade for the scholarship are stated on the ICESCO pages. The number of places is small (five in total) and the second phase is not described.
age_experience_notes: No age limit and no work experience requirement are stated on the pages read.
funding_summary: Each scholarship covers tuition fees, student housing, a monthly stipend and access to health coverage through public healthcare institutions. The stipend amount, the length of funding and travel costs are not stated on the pages read.
programmes_note: Bachelor's only. Tashkent State Medical University: General Medicine (3 places). Green University: Environmental and Sustainable Management; Environment and Economics; Ecology and Public Administration (2 places in total, not divided between the three programmes on the pages read). The ICESCO announcement words the last programme as Environmental Science and Public Administration, while its own programme list and the Ugandan notice say Ecology and Public Administration. All Green University programmes are taught in English per the university's pages.
institutions_note: Two universities in Uzbekistan in the first phase: Tashkent State Medical University and the Central Asian University for Environmental and Climate Change Studies (also called Green University or Central Asian Green University, under the National Committee on Ecology and Climate Change). The applicant chooses one of the two when applying.

requirements.text: Proof of English. Tashkent State Medical University: B1 or higher (IELTS 5.0 or equivalent). Green University: IELTS 5.5 or higher, TOEFL PBT 453 / CBT 133 / iBT 46, or a certificate from a fully English-taught international secondary school; if none, take the university entrance exam (IELTS-like format on environment, ecology and climate change).

Format rules for every document: clear and legible, in English or with a certified English translation, PDF format, at most 5 MB per file. The ICESCO pages do not give the list of documents; it is inside the online application.
Passport, photo (3x4 cm), English CV and English motivation essay of 250 to 300 words, as listed in the Green University's general rules for foreign applicants for state grants.

application_steps.title: Check you are a national of an ICESCO member state
application_steps.detail: Only nationals of the 53 ICESCO member states can apply. Choose between the two universities: Tashkent State Medical University for General Medicine, or Green University for its environment-related programmes.

application_steps.title: Prepare English proof and documents
application_steps.detail: Prepare proof of English for the chosen university and your documents as clear PDFs of at most 5 MB each, in English or with a certified English translation. Green University applicants without a valid English certificate must sit the university entrance exam.

application_steps.title: Submit the application through ICESCO's online application
application_steps.detail: Applications opened on 1 March 2026 and the deadline was 15 May 2026; early submission is strongly encouraged. Some national ministries add their own step: Uganda's Ministry of Education asked applicants to print the online application with attachments and deliver a copy to the ministry.

application_steps.title: Possible interview and entrance exam
application_steps.detail: After you submit, you may be invited to an interview. Green University applicants without a valid English certificate take the entrance exam. The ICESCO pages do not describe scoring or who makes the final choice.

application_steps.title: University evaluation rules (Green University, general foreign grant rules)
application_steps.detail: In the university's general rules for foreign applicants for state grants, selection is out of 100 with a minimum of 70: interview up to 70 points (subject knowledge up to 40, logical thinking up to 20, motivation up to 10) and essay up to 30 points; ties go to the higher GPA. The university does not say this applies to the ICESCO places.

application_steps.title: Enrolment steps are not described by ICESCO
application_steps.detail: The ICESCO pages say nothing about results, acceptance, visa, arrival or obligations. Green University's general rules say enrolment of foreign grant holders is finalised after signing a Grant Agreement and submitting original notarised and translated documents, and the rector then issues the enrolment order.

fetch_problems: The ICESCO scholarship listing page shows only the overview and two university entries; the application form itself was not opened.

The Tashkent State Medical University admissions page opened was the Autumn 2025 general international intake (online interview, health certificate, A-1 visa) and is not tied to the ICESCO places, so it was not used for facts.
notes: Green University's own entrance-exam page lists IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 61 as the English options for its general admission, whereas ICESCO's programme page for the scholarship says IELTS 5.5 and TOEFL iBT 46. The file follows the ICESCO page for the scholarship.

The university's own bachelor's page lists four programmes (Ecology and Public Administration, Environmental and Sustainable Management, Jurisprudence, Green Economy); the ICESCO listing names three programmes, including Environment and Economics.
The Ugandan Ministry of Education notice gives the academic year as 2026/2027, which the ICESCO pages do not state.
This file lists each benefit separately instead of giving a single funding label, as the brief requires.
Stored stipend and travel gaps are unchanged: none of the pages read gives them.
